save_backup.title: Save before the outgoing transition
save_backup.why: The next map cannot return to this area's fixed triggers.
save_backup.detail: Keep one save from before the outgoing doorway, portal, arena completion, or demo exit until every listed counter is reconciled.

point_of_no_return.title: The map exit closes this checklist
point_of_no_return.why: Crossing the outgoing trigger loads a different map.
point_of_no_return.detail: Check the statistics and every listed location before committing.

levels.1: Explore until the current environment feels exhausted before accepting its exit.
levels.2: Clear the active route and reach the outgoing map transition.
levels.3: Finish every encounter that actually activates, complete the fixed-location checklist below, preserve the result on a manual save, and only then cross the outgoing transition.

levels.1: The statistics screen can catch a missed detour before it becomes a replay.
levels.2: Before leaving, verify 9 registering secrets and the enemies that actually spawned in this map.
levels.3: Open the statistics before the exit. The secret total must show 9; the demo's broken curiosity is excluded. Clear all reachable enemies, but judge the kill result by activated spawns because this engine retains known dormant-spawner discrepancies.

areas.name: Completion Ledger
areas.location_cue: The campaign, extras, difficulty, statistics, and cumulative-record menus after the map routes are familiar.
areas.note: These records collect mode-specific and cumulative tasks without using achievement framing.

save_backup.title: Keep end-of-map and challenge setups
save_backup.why: Several restrictions and cumulative farms are quickest to retry from purpose-built manual saves.
save_backup.detail: Retain the Sierra challenge starts, the late gravity room, dense swarm rooms, and each difficulty completion record.

levels.1: The regular completion record has a harder counterpart.
levels.2: Start the retail campaign on Serious and complete it without changing difficulty.
levels.3: Begin a fresh single-player campaign with Serious selected. Finish every retail map on that same setting, keep manual saves before fragile secret triggers, and retain the completion save.

levels.1: An additional difficulty becomes relevant after the standard high-difficulty route.
levels.2: Complete the retail campaign on Mental to unlock the hidden setting normally.
levels.3: Start a separate Mental campaign and finish the full retail route without lowering the setting. Preserve its completion record; that clear is the normal in-game prerequisite for I Am Ugh-Zan.

levels.1: The hidden setting asks for one conclusive clear rather than another exploratory sweep.
levels.2: After unlocking I Am Ugh-Zan, complete The Grand Cathedral on that setting.
levels.3: First complete Mental mode so I Am Ugh-Zan appears in the difficulty menu. Load The Grand Cathedral with it selected, finish the map, and retain the resulting completion record.

levels.1: A survival record watches how long you continue at the smallest possible health value.
levels.2: On Normal or harder, reduce health to exactly 1 and keep progressing through an active encounter.
levels.3: Use Sierra's early rocket launcher and controlled splash damage to reach exactly 1 health, quick-save, then advance through the first active waves without healing. The current build exposes no numeric threshold; continue until the record appears, reloading the setup if you die.

levels.1: The opening map has a movement-restriction route.
levels.2: Complete Sierra de Chiapas on Normal or harder without issuing a jump input.
levels.3: Bind jump away or avoid the key entirely, select Normal or harder, and finish Sierra de Chiapas. Bounce pads and scripted movement are acceptable; a manual jump invalidates the attempt.

levels.1: The opening map also rewards a perfectly clean run.
levels.2: Complete Sierra de Chiapas on Normal or harder without losing health or armor.
levels.3: Start Sierra de Chiapas on Normal or harder with a fresh save. Save before each arena, reload after any hit, avoid damaging secret detours, and cross the map exit with no damage received.

levels.1: Most opening encounters can be bypassed if the route is planned carefully.
levels.2: Complete Sierra de Chiapas on Normal or harder with no more than seven credited eliminations.
levels.3: Avoid optional fights, use movement and switches to escape open areas, and kill only what blocks progression. Keep the displayed count at seven or less; drownings and other environmental deaths can still be credited to you, so reload if the tally rises unexpectedly.

levels.1: One map can be cleared with the starting blade alone.
levels.2: Finish any Second Encounter retail map on Normal or harder using only the knife.
levels.3: Choose a familiar map on Normal or harder, never fire or damage an enemy with another weapon, and cross its exit after relying exclusively on the knife. Passive pickups do not matter; attacking with them does.

levels.1: Repeat the blade-only restriction for a second completed map.
levels.2: Record two knife-only map completions on Normal or harder.
levels.3: After the first valid knife-only clear, complete another retail map under the same restriction. Keep separate end-of-map saves so a failed registration can be retried without repeating both routes.

levels.1: Time spent under altered gravity accumulates across sessions.
levels.2: Accumulate sixty minutes of gravity-altered movement; The City of the Gods has a stable late chamber.
levels.3: Reach the gravity-changing chamber in The City of the Gods, make a manual save, and remain in the altered field until the cumulative total reaches sixty minutes. Movement is optional; reload the save only if the field ends.

levels.1: A very large weapon-specific total benefits from a repeatable swarm.
levels.2: Eliminate 5,000 marsh-hoppers with the chainsaw; The Pit contains a dense repeatable room.
levels.3: Save immediately before The Pit's gravity swarm, equip the chainsaw, clear every marsh-hopper it can safely reach, then reload and repeat. The weapon total is cumulative, so continue until 5,000 chainsaw eliminations have registered.

levels.1: The Revolution-only hidden weapon has its own cumulative combat total.
levels.2: After finding the Minelayer, eliminate 100 enemies with deployed mines.
levels.3: Collect the secret Minelayer in Land of the Damned, save before a dense ground wave, place mines across its approach, and reload after the wave. Repeat until the cumulative mine total reaches 100.

levels.1: The lifetime ledger continues across saves and repeated encounters.
levels.2: Raise the cumulative enemy total to 100,001.
levels.3: Save before a dense late-game wave, clear it quickly, and reload the setup; repeated eliminations continue feeding the lifetime ledger. Continue until the displayed cumulative total reaches 100,001.

levels.1: Damage accumulates alongside the lifetime elimination ledger.
levels.2: Deal a cumulative 1,000,000 points of enemy damage.
levels.3: Use the same repeatable high-density save as the lifetime elimination run. Favor high-damage weapons, finish each spawned group before reloading, and continue until the cumulative damage ledger reaches 1,000,000.

levels.1: A limited-life cooperative variant scatters a separate currency route.
levels.2: In one Coin-op run, gather at least 100 gold coins across the early maps.
levels.3: Collect these groups in order: Sierra's pyramid ledges (8), speed doorway (1), and pond logs (10); Valley's fan bridge (4), blue ramps (2), roof (1), pyramid stairs (6), and central pedestal (8); City's column path (6), mask jumps (3), jaguar statues (2), raised-door rear (2), slide (10), and lava platforms (6); then Serpent's entrance (6), descent (3), corner rear (7), forcefield yard (6), long pool (5), and jaguar exterior (6). The running total reaches 102, providing a two-coin margin.

levels.1: The central completion record comes from a full solo route.
levels.2: Complete every retail map in the single-player Second Encounter campaign.
levels.3: Use the campaign menu, finish each retail map without skipping through custom level selection, and retain the completion save. The separate Palenque Demo is audited independently below.

levels.1: The installed extras include an earlier version of the opening environment.
levels.2: Launch Palenque Demo from Extras and complete it with nine registered secrets.
levels.3: Open the standalone Palenque Demo, follow its own ten-location checklist, and leave only when the counter shows 9. The invulnerability ledge is still worth visiting, but its broken trigger cannot raise the total.

levels.1: Review the per-map totals before considering the route complete.
levels.2: Confirm all 135 applicable Classic/Revolution campaign secrets across the retail maps.
levels.3: Reconcile every map against this pack until the combined applicable count is 135. HD-, VR-, and Xbox-only records are excluded; the two Revolution-only weapon secrets are included.

levels.1: Different releases quietly alter counters and room layouts.
levels.2: Do not pursue placements identified only for HD, VR, or the original Xbox conversion.
levels.3: This pack follows the Classic campaign inside Serious Sam Classics: Revolution. It includes the Revolution Plasmathrower and Minelayer but reserves HD tree, statue, teleporter, and platform additions, and Xbox-exclusive rooms, for their own packs.

levels.1: A short kill result does not always mean an enemy remains alive.
levels.2: Use activated enemies, not an unreachable nominal maximum, to judge each map's combat sweep.
levels.3: Before every exit, search delayed and secret-triggered waves. If the map remains short after all triggers and no enemy is present, record the displayed result rather than inventing a route to a dormant engine spawner.
